title: LatestDepositResponse
description: Response shape for `GetLatestDeposit`. `deposit` is `None` on a freshly deployed contract.

Deposit.description: Opaque on-chain record of a deposit: the depositor-claimed bs58-encoded ed25519 identity public key. The contract does not verify control of the corresponding private key.

DepositData.description: `(deposit_id, deposit)` pair surfaced by the latest-deposit and paginated deposit queries.
